resources.string:
Clean City Reporter is a course project prototype. By creating an account you agree to the following.

1. Purpose
The app lets residents report waste and sanitation problems in Nairobi, and lets authorised staff review and update those reports.

2. Information we collect
Your full name, email address, phone number and password (stored in a protected form). For each report: the category, your description, a photograph and the location you type in.

3. How it is used
Your information is used only to run the reporting service: to identify you, to attach reports to your account, and to send you updates about your reports. It is not sold or shared for advertising.

4. Photos and location
Photos are only taken or chosen when you ask, and the app asks your permission first. You decide what location text to enter.

5. Your responsibilities
Submit genuine reports with accurate details. Do not upload offensive, private or misleading content. False or abusive reports may lead to your account being deactivated.

6. Who can see your reports
You can see your own reports. Authorised response officers and administrators can see reports and your contact details so they can act on them. Only they can change a report's official status.

7. Account security
Keep your password private. Staff accounts cannot be created through Sign Up.

8. Changes
These terms may change as the project develops.
